chaps: Use RSA_generate_key_ex() As of OpenSSL 0.9.8, RSA_generate_key() is deprecated in favor of RSA_generate_key_ex(). RSA_generate_key_ex() requires passing in a BIGNUM* exponent, for which we use a crypto::ScopedBIGNUM. Make these changes along with adding proper NULL->nullptr and NULL checks. The end result is no functional change, but better alignment for openssl 1.1 migration. shill: vpn: Stop overridding SetConnection CL:1748120 introduced a regression by triggering a latent infinite loop that was not previously reachable because the previous SetConnection override did not work as "intended". Ever since it was introduced in CL:22461, the VPNService::SetConnection override essentially behaved as if it wasn't there at all. Since Device::DestroyConnection calls Service::SetConnection(nullptr) prior to destroying the Connection instance, and since rebinding a Binder does *not* cause--nor has it ever caused--the client_disconnect_callback to be called, the Binder in VPNService::SetConnection was never bound to a Connection during the destruction of the Connection.
